node.title: Re: reinstall Strawberry perl loses getopts.pl
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
getopts.pl was [doc://perl5160delta#Removed-Modules-and-Pragmata|removed in Perl v5.16]. Although you could install [mod://Perl4::CoreLibs] to get it back, I'd strongly recommend you switch to the core module [doc://Getopt::Std] or [doc://Getopt::Long] - often the replacement is pretty simple; in particular, have a look at getopts from [doc://Getopt::Std].

[https://metacpan.org/source/ZEFRAM/Perl4-CoreLibs-0.004/lib/getopts.pl|getopts.pl] says:

This library is no longer being maintained, and is included for backward compatibility with Perl 4 programs which may require it.

In particular, this should not be used as an example of modern Perl programming techniques.

Suggested alternatives: Getopt::Long or Getopt::Std
